This animation shows the rise in global mean sea level from 1993 to 2024 based on data from a series of five international satellites. The zeropoint in the graph is set to the start of 1993, and a 60 day Gaussian filter is applied to the data. This NASA-led analysis is based on a sea level data set featuring more than 30 years of satellite observations, starting with the U.S.-French TOPEX/Poseidon mission, which launched in 1992. The Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich mission, which launched in November 2020, is the latest in the series of satellites that have contributed to this sea level record. For more information on sea level change, visit [earth.gov/sealevel](http://earth.gov/sealevel).
